result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, community-led framing. Opens with philanthropy and sustainability initiatives and social-impact claims; the first-person plural 'we' is used throughout. Commitments are largely hedged ('we believe', 'we work to'). Most of the page is historical timeline and business facts, which are not coded. Customers, employees, and safety receive little or no stated attention.
